Guitar Hero Project - total notes for every Guitar Hero song

Guitar Hero Project lists the total number of notes in every song of Guitar Hero (PlayStation 2), Guitar Hero II (PlayStation 2 and Xbox 360), Guitar Hero Encore: Rocks the 80s (PlayStation 2), Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock and Guitar Hero: Aerosmith (both on PlayStation 2, Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, Wii and PC) and Guitar Hero World Tour (PC, guitar, bass and drums), on Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert. The table is sorted from the song with the fewest notes to the song with the most, and can be narrowed down by game, platform, difficulty and instrument. It covers the career songs, bonus tracks, secret songs and demo disc songs of each version. Songs played at 100% can be ticked off, and a bar shows how many are done. The note counts come from the song stats on ScoreHero, and for World Tour from the PC game's own chart files.

Guitar Hero Project
Songs at 100%

Total note counts for every song in Guitar Hero, Guitar Hero II, Guitar Hero Encore: Rocks the 80s, Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock, Guitar Hero: Aerosmith and Guitar Hero World Tour (PC), on every difficulty, sorted from fewest to most notes. Note counts from ScoreHero, and for World Tour from the PC game's own chart files.

How to use it

  1. Tick the games, platforms, difficulties and instruments to show in the table.
  2. Tick a group's heading to show or hide the whole group.
  3. Read the table from the top: fewest notes first, most notes last.
  4. Tick the 100% box on every song you have played at 100%.

Your ticks are saved in this browser.
